# third_party

Vendored sources built by the NDK through `third_party/proot.cmake`, which is
included from `app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt`. Only source files are kept
(no `.git`, tests or docs).

| Component | Upstream | Pinned version | Integrity | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PRoot | https://github.com/termux/proot | commit `52d65a4dc140ca554d241a1438ddd4f6b00c9813` (tag `v5.1.107.102`, 2026-11-01) | git commit hash | GPL-2.0-or-later (`proot/COPYING`) |
| talloc | https://www.samba.org/ftp/talloc/talloc-2.4.4.tar.gz | 2.4.4 | sha256 `55e47994018c13743485544e7206780ffbb3c8495e704a99636503e6e77abf59` | LGPL-3.0-or-later (`talloc/LICENSE`) |

## Contents

- `proot/src/` — unmodified `src/` of termux/proot, plus `COPYING` and the
  upstream `README.md`.
- `talloc/` — unmodified `talloc.c`, `talloc.h`, `LICENSE`, `NEWS` and
  `lib/replace/` headers/sources from the 2.4.4 tarball (its `tests/`,
  `wscript`, `configure` and `Makefile` were dropped).
- `talloc/android/config.h` — hand-written stand-in for the waf-generated
  `config.h` (bionic, API 31), following Termux's `libtalloc` cross-answers.
- `talloc/android/replace_android.c` — `rep_memset_s()`, the only libreplace
  fallback `talloc.c` needs on bionic.
- `proot.cmake` — CMake port of `proot/src/GNUmakefile`:
  - `talloc_static` → `libtalloc.a` (`talloc.c` + `replace_android.c`).
  - `proot_loader` → `libproot_loader.so`: `loader/loader.c` + `loader/assembly.S`,
    `-fPIC -ffreestanding`, linked `-static -nostdlib
    -Wl,--build-id=none,-Ttext=0x5400000000,--rosegment,-z,noexecstack`
    (`LOADER_ADDRESS` of `ARCH_ARM64` in `arch.h`).
  - `proot_exe` → `libproot.so` (PIE), same object list as the makefile, with
    `-DARG_MAX=131072` (as Termux) and `PROOT_UNBUNDLE_LOADER`, so the loader
    is not embedded and is located through the `PROOT_LOADER` variable.
  - `build.h`: `VERSION` and `HAVE_PROCESS_VM` / `HAVE_SECCOMP_FILTER`, decided
    by compiling the upstream `.check_*.c` programs with the NDK.
  - `loader-info.c`: generated by `proot_loader_info.cmake` (port of
    `loader/loader-info.awk`) from the loader's symbol table.
  - No 32-bit loader: the target SoC has no aarch32.
  - Both executables are copied to `CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` so AGP
    packages them in `lib/arm64-v8a/` and Android extracts them to
    `nativeLibraryDir` with exec permission.

## Runtime

```
PROOT_LOADER=<nativeLibraryDir>/libproot_loader.so \
PROOT_TMP_DIR=<app data dir>/cache \
<nativeLibraryDir>/libproot.so --kill-on-exit --link2symlink -0 \
    -r <filesDir>/rootfs -b /dev -b /proc -b /sys -w /root \
    /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/root PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin TERM=xterm /bin/bash
```

## Updating

1. Pick a new termux/proot commit, replace `proot/src`, update the commit,
   tag and `HP_PROOT_VERSION` in `proot.cmake`, and diff `src/GNUmakefile`
   against the source list and flags in `proot.cmake`.
2. For talloc, download the new tarball, record its sha256 here, bump
   `TALLOC_BUILD_VERSION_*` in `talloc/android/config.h` and re-check the
   undefined symbols of `talloc.o` against bionic.

## Parches locales de Exedra64
- `proot/src/syscall/enter.c` (`PR_execveat`): si `dirfd != AT_FDCWD` pero la ruta es absoluta, se trata como `execve` (el kernel ignora `dirfd` en ese caso). Necesario porque FEX-Emu se re-ejecuta con `execveat(fd, "/proc/self/exe", ...)`; sin esto Wine no puede lanzar procesos hijos.
